edges: Thorpe Athelny has lived in Toledo, Spain.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: H.G. Wells describes his first encounter with the King of Italy, noting the monarch's lack of pomp.
Philip is sent to live with his uncle William.
Philip is the son of Helen Carey.
Philip Carey falls in love with Mildred.
Philip is sent to live with his aunt Louisa.
Philip meets Mildred while studying medicine.
Fanny Price falls in love with Philip.
Philip finds a job at a department store.
Philip decides to go to Germany.
H.G. Wells sees a possibility of victory in 1917 but acknowledges the war may continue into 1918 or 1919.
Philip is sent to a boarding school.
Philip finds that Sally likes him.
H.G. Wells portrays General Joffre as a representation of the common man and the finest qualities of the Allies' war.
H.G. Wells introduces the character Hallery who is obsessed with the Mind of the Race.
H.G. Wells expresses confidence that the Allies will ultimately defeat Germany through new tactics.
H.G. Wells describes a tour of a munitions factory given by André Citroën.
Mildred falls in love with Philip's friend Harry Griffiths.
Philip Carey enters into an affair with Norah Nesbit after Mildred leaves him.
Philip works with Dr. South at a hospital.
Philip becomes engaged to Sally Athelny.
